messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: more operations
parts:
Ben said:
> Also, it would be good if there were an optimized implementation for the dot product of a vector with itself.

That's a good idea, too.

dot_self(vector)

You only need half the storage that way. That function
doesn't exist, but it should be added.

I also like the idea of doing the wrap-multiply,
though I don't know what to call it:

wrap_multiply(u,v) = u' * v * u

You had also talked about adding all sorts of
distribution parameterizations for Cholesky factors.

At this point, I think everything's stable enough that
adding new functions is independent of everything else.

Just please add unit tests. Some of these are pretty
easy to write because you can always lean on the
more basic implementations, which compute the gradients
for you.

- Bob
